objective: Upgrade this repository to the Lovable target architecture with a fully functional backend, authenticated internal dashboard, and compliant external frontend. Produce exactly one final PR only when all acceptance gates pass.
method: Ensure agentic internal dashboard endpoints exist
Migrate to TanStack Router (if not present)
Migrate to TanStack Query for data fetching (if not present)
Delegate frontend refinement to GLM-4.7 if enabled
Run all gates (install, lint, typecheck, test, build, e2e, visual)
rules: Do not open a PR until all gates pass
Do not modify forbidden paths (infra/prod/**, secrets/**, **/*.env)
Use pnpm for all package management
Write BLOCKER.md if you encounter unresolvable issues

router.migration_required: Check if React Router is used, migrate to TanStack Router

query.migration_required: Check if fetch/axios is used directly, migrate to TanStack Query

patterns.use_loader_pattern: TanStack Router loaders for data preloading

install.failure_action: Fix package.json conflicts, remove incompatible packages

lint.failure_action: Auto-fix with eslint --fix, manually resolve remaining

typecheck.failure_action: Fix type errors, add proper type annotations

test.failure_action: Fix failing tests, update snapshots if needed

build.failure_action: Fix build errors, ensure all imports resolve

e2e.failure_action: Fix e2e failures, update selectors if UI changed

visual.success: Visual regression tests pass or differences approved
visual.failure_action: Review visual diffs, update baselines if intentional
